title: Floods Force Gaza to Choose Between Clean Water and Pumping Out Sewage
summary: As Israeli restrictions limit repairs in Gaza, fuel is being diverted from wells to drainage pumps.
llm_summary: The recent floods in Gaza have left residents forced to pick either clean drinking water or the ability to pump out sewage, because fuel supplies are being diverted from water wells to power drainage pumps.
